taskDescription: Macro that runs commissioning package data to Excel. Uses ONERROR/GOLABEL error trap, imports GridControl and Aveva.Engineering.Tags.Pml, initializes a logger, builds empty-pattern and replacement-data arrays, collects all named RAMCommissioningPackages via COLLECT ALL, iterates with DO/ENDDO, runs nested COLLECT ALL with $! variable substitution, calls external export function, handles errors with SAVEWORK/UNCLAIM ALL and error logging, finishes with FINISH.

benchmarkContent:
-- Benchmark: comm package data export to Excel
-- Demonstrates: error handling, imports, namespaces, ARRAY, DATETIME,
--   COLLECT ALL iteration, 2D array attributes, string manipulation,
--   file path construction, FINISH
-- Patterns confirmed via KB: controlflow, objects, arrays, macros

ONERROR GOLABEL /Error

import 'GridControl'
handle any
endhandle

import 'Aveva.Engineering.Tags.Pml'
handle any
endhandle

using namespace 'Aveva.Core.Presentation'
using namespace 'Aveva.Engineering.Tags'

-- Initialise logging heading via logger object
!!ramCommonLogger = object RAMCOMMONLOGGER()
!headings = |Tag Name;Attribute Name;Error Text|
!!ramCommonLogger.addHeading(!headings.split(|;|))

-- Configuration path and data structures
!pathName = |C:\Data\Exports\commReports|
!realUnset = ARRAY()
!dt = OBJECT DATETIME()
!year = !dt.year()
!month = !dt.month().string('I2')
!date = !dt.date().string('I2')
!hour = !dt.hour().string('I2')
!minute = !dt.minute().string('I2')

-- Build list of empty / placeholder value patterns to detect
!emptyPatternString = |Unset unset UNSET|
!emptyPatternList = !emptyPatternString.split()
!emptyPatternList.append(| |)
!emptyPatternList.append(||)
!emptyPatternList.append(|0ampere|)

-- Replacement map: large numeric sentinel values → 'NA'
!isErrorReport = false
!replaceData = object ARRAY()
!replaceData.append('999999999ampere;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999deg/s;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999degC;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999kg;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999kg;NA')
!replaceData.append('99999kg;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999kg/m3;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999kg/s;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999kW;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999m/s;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999993m/s;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999m3/s;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999mm;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999mm2;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999Pa.s;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999pascal;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999Ratio;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999second;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999volt;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999999N/m;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999mm;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999;NA')
!replaceData.append('99999;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999000;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999993;NA')
!replaceData.append('9999999000ampere;NA')
!replaceData.append('999999ampere;NA')
!replaceData.append('N/A;NA')
!replaceData.append('N.A;NA')
!replaceData.append('N.A.;NA')
!replaceData.append('Area-NA;NA')
!replaceData.append('PU-NA;NA')
!replaceData.append('PO-NA;NA')
!replaceData.append('SECE-NA;NA')
!replaceData.append('01/01/1990 00:00:00;NA')

-- 2D array: common attributes (column 1 = attribute expression, column 2 = display label)
!commonAttributes = object ARRAY()
!commonAttributes[1][1] = ':RAMTagOwner'
!commonAttributes[1][2] = 'Tag Owner'
!commonAttributes[2][1] = ':TagStatus'
!commonAttributes[2][2] = 'Tag Status'
!commonAttributes[3][1] = 'NAMN of :TagRefToPurchaseOrder'
!commonAttributes[3][2] = 'PO Number'
!commonAttributes[4][1] = ':RAMPackageNumber of :TagRefToPurchaseOrder'
!commonAttributes[4][2] = 'Package'
!commonAttributes[5][1] = ':TagClassName'
!commonAttributes[5][2] = 'Shell Class'
!commonAttributes[6][1] = 'NAMN of :TagRefToMCPackage'
!commonAttributes[6][2] = 'MC Package'
!commonAttributes[7][1] = 'NAMN of :MCPackageToCommissioningPackageRef of :TagRefToMCPackage'
!commonAttributes[7][2] = 'Comm Package'
!commonAttributes[8][1] = 'NAMN of :TagRefToArea'
!commonAttributes[8][2] = 'Area'
!commonAttributes[9][1] = ':RambollTagStatus'
!commonAttributes[9][2] = 'Maturity'
!commonAttributes[10][1] = 'NAMN of :TagRefToProcessUnit'
!commonAttributes[10][2] = 'Process Unit'
!commonAttributes[11][1] = ':RAMInstallationContractors'
!commonAttributes[11][2] = 'Install By'
!commonAttributes[12][1] = 'REPLACE(IFT(:TagName of :TagRefToParentTag neq NAMN of :TagRefToParentTag and (not(unset(:TagName of :TagRefToParentTag)) and not(empty(:TagName of :TagRefToParentTag))), :TagName of :TagRefToParentTag, NAMN of :TagRefToParentTag), |‐|, |-|)'
!commonAttributes[12][2] = 'Parent Tag'

-- Collect commissioning packages and iterate
var !commPckgList collect all (:RAMCommissioningPackage) with (isnamed)
do !commPckgName values !commPckgList
    !commPckg = !commPckgName.dbref()
    !tagFilter = 'NOT(:TagStatus inset (|VOID|, |Future|)) and ISNAMED and NOT(EMPTY(:RAMTAGOWNER)) and matchwild(namn of :TagRefToMCPackage, |*$!<commPckg.namn>*|)'
    var !tagList collect all (ENGITE) with ($!tagFilter)
    !size = !tagList.size()
    if (!size gt 0) then
        !rdlFilter = |:RDLSource eq 'AKSO_Tag Properties Templates_Rev6'|
        !filePathRam = |$!pathName\_master\data\comm_data\commReport-$!<commPckg.namn>.xlsx|
        !!jacExportRDLDataReportMatrix(!filePathRam, !rdlFilter, !tagFilter, !emptyPatternList, !commonAttributes, !replaceData, !isErrorReport)
    endif
enddo

-- Error handler label
LABEL /Error
handle any
    SAVEWORK
    UNCLAIM ALL
    !dt = OBJECT DATETIME()
    !year = !dt.year()
    !month = !dt.month().string('I2')
    !date = !dt.date().string('I2')
    !hour = !dt.hour().string('I2')
    !minute = !dt.minute().string('I2')
    !!ramCommonLogger.writeErrorDataToExcel(|C:\Data\Exports\Logs\commisioningReport-log_$!<year>-$!<month>-$!<date>-$!<hour>.xlsx|, false)
endhandle

FINISH
originalSemantics: Macro that collects all named RAMCommissioningPackages, iterates through them, collects ENGITE tags matching a per-package filter, and exports tag properties to individual Excel files via an external function jacExportRDLDataReportMatrix. Uses ONERROR/GOLABEL error trap with SAVEWORK/UNCLAIM ALL cleanup and error logging to Excel.
